confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Cocktail (about 2.7 times beer) and wine (about 1.2 times beer) were cross-checked against the beer anchor because bar and wine-by-the-glass knowledge is less precise. July is peak season, so hostel and hotel anchors are least certain. EUR-to-USD uses an assumed rate of about 1.16, not a searched source. The 15 October RBA reading appeared in search results from the RBA exchange-rates table but was not checked against the F11.1 download.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned from general knowledge of Lisbon price levels, cross-checked against comparable southern European tourist capitals with similar summer demand, such as Porto and Madrid. No single city was copied directly.

anchor_basis.beer: 0.33 l draft domestic beer (Super Bock or Sagres) at a mid-range restaurant, about €3.75
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a neighborhood café, about €2.40
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: dish of the day (prato do dia) at a neighborhood tasca, about €12 per person
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course mid-range restaurant meal for two without drinks, about €70 for the pair
anchor_basis.cocktail: standard cocktail at a central bar, about €10
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house wine by the glass at a restaurant, about €4.50
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: peak-summer dorm bed in a central registered hostel, about €33 per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room in a central hostel, about €90 per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic double room at a registered residencial (guesthouse), about €85 per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: double room at a registered three-star hotel, about €170 per night
